changesProposed.name: Engine Ventures

verified.name: Engine Ventures
verified.thesis: Engine Ventures is a venture capital firm focused on early-stage Tough Tech companies that solve the world's most challenging problems through transformational science and engineering. The firm invests in companies developing hardware-based technologies across deep tech fields including biotech, robotics, green energy, agriculture, manufacturing, material science, and quantum computing.
verified.notes: Engine Ventures spun out as a separate investment firm from The Engine nonprofit incubator in 2023. The Engine is a nonprofit organization founded by MIT in 2016. Sources 4 and 5 are news articles unrelated to Engine Ventures and were not used for verification.

changesProposed.name: Y Combinator

verified.name: Y Combinator
verified.thesis: Y Combinator invests $500,000 per company ($125,000 for 7% equity on post-money SAFE and $375,000 on uncapped SAFE with MFN clause) in startups selected four times per year. Founders move to San Francisco for three months of intensive mentorship, office hours, and community support, culminating in Demo Day where they present to investors.
verified.notes: Garry Tan became President and CEO in January 2023 (source 2). Jared Friedman succeeded Michael Seibel as Managing Partner in March 2024 (source 2). Headquarters relocated from Mountain View to San Francisco in spring 2023 (source 2). No sector focus explicitly stated in sources; database entry claiming 'Hard Tech, Defense, Space, Robotics' cannot be verified.
